subject.title: [Bug]: Discord elevated allowFrom fallback from channels.discord.allowFrom does not work on 2026.3.22

question: Should Discord elevated mode continue to treat `channels.discord.allowFrom` as the fallback for omitted `tools.elevated.allowFrom.discord`, or should elevated access require an explicit `tools.elevated.allowFrom.discord` allowlist going forward?
rationale: Both choices are plausible but security-sensitive: honoring the shipped docs restores a user-facing contract, while explicit-only elevated allowlists preserve a narrower host-exec authorization boundary.

options.title: Restore the released fallback
options.body: Implement a narrow Discord fallback through the channel plugin hook, make `sandbox explain` share the same resolution, preserve explicit empty-list override behavior, and add focused regression tests.

options.title: Retire the fallback explicitly
options.body: Keep elevated auth explicit-only, ship the current docs direction in a release note, and close or decline the conflicting fallback PRs with the security rationale.

options.title: Defer until PR refresh
options.body: Keep this issue open while the linked PR is refreshed, then make the security-contract decision during PR review.

recommendation.title: Restore the released fallback
recommendation.body: Implement a narrow Discord fallback through the channel plugin hook, make `sandbox explain` share the same resolution, preserve explicit empty-list override behavior, and add focused regression tests.
